attribution_text: This research has made use of the SIMBAD database, operated at CDS, Strasbourg, France.
cache_ttl: not applicable to immutable repository artifact.
failure_and_fallback_behaviour: fail closed; no live fallback or unrelated data.
fetch_time_policy: The reviewed retrieval timestamp is retained in the DataManifest.
fixture_and_checksum_strategy: Reviewed 110-row CSV plus exact SHA-256; acquisition raw bytes retained outside the repository only for review evidence.
known_limitations: SIMBAD is continuously maintained; Lumina pins the retrieval time and normalized bytes rather than a provider release number.
Coordinate quality and bibliography are retained as evidence and are not converted to a Lumina confidence score.
observation_or_publication_time_policy: SIMBAD ICRS coordinate fields expose the reviewed J2000.0 representation.
purpose: Offline ingestion of one reviewed Messier 1 through 110 SIMBAD snapshot.
rate_or_fair_use_constraints: Acquisition and verification only; runtime and CI make no provider requests.
refresh_schedule: none; Lumina v1 snapshot is pinned.
